# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 18 Aug 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## New Home Sales & Supply Pipeline

- **New private home sales rebounded sharply in July 2026** - Developers sold 731 new private homes (excluding ECs) in July 2026, up 368.6% from June's 156 units, marking the strongest sales month since April as fresh launches returned after an unusually quiet June. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/new-home-sales-rebound-to-3-month-high-as-july-launches-return/)

- **Two new GLS sites in Marina South and Orchard Boulevard released** - URA released two Government Land Sales sites — Marina Gardens Lane (6,007.4 sqm) and Orchard Boulevard (3,438.0 sqm) — that could together add around 500 private homes to Singapore's housing pipeline. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/two-new-gls-sites-released-in-marina-south-and-orchard-boulevard/)

## HDB vs Private Market

- **HDB resale prices falling while condo prices rise, widening the upgrader gap** - The HDB resale price index fell in 2Q2026 while private condo prices rose, with observers noting the two markets may be pulling in separate directions, creating a widening affordability gap for would-be upgraders. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/hdb-prices-are-falling-while-condo-prices-rise-but-upgraders-have-a-bigger-problem/)

- **Survey: Only 55% of HDB owners still aspire to private housing** - A 2026 PropNex survey of 1,530 HDB owners found that only 55.1% still aspire to private housing, with accessibility and neighbourhood ties now outweighing prestige in upgrading decisions. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/a-new-survey-reveals-what-77-of-hdb-owners-want-most-in-their-next-home-and-its-not-price-or-space/)

## Lease Decay & Ageing Stock

- **Orchard Court unit with 46 years left on lease sold for S$2.15 million** - A 1,442 sqft unit at Orchard Court — whose lease began in 1973 — changed hands for S$2.15 million in Q2 2026, highlighting ongoing buyer interest in ageing leasehold condos despite shorter remaining tenures. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/are-older-condos-worth-buying/)

- **Lease decay considerations growing as Singapore's housing stock ages** - Shorter remaining leases are increasingly affecting future demand, CPF usage, financing options, and resale prospects for buyers of older properties. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/ask-an-agent-your-lease-decay-property-questions-answered/)
